body.name: \(h_{t,F}\)
body.construction: Run rational reduced-row-echelon elimination on \(A_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}\lambda=b_{\eta,t,F}\). If the system is consistent, return \(\mathsf{REJECT}\). If it is inconsistent, compute the fundamental rational null vectors of \(A_{\eta,t,F}u=0\), in increasing order of their free-column indices, and select the first vector \(z\) for which \(b_{\eta,t,F}^{\mathsf T}z\ne0\). Multiply \(z\) by the least positive integer that clears all its denominators, and change its sign when necessary so that its inner product with \(b_{\eta,t,F}\) is positive. The resulting integer, hence rational, vector is \(h_{t,F}\).
